title: Introduce location classifier RBAC adapter and audit entropy reducer
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: Customers requested finer-grained region-aware operator controls and stronger audit privacy guarantees when KMS provider metadata is attached to requests. This PR adds a lightweight Location Classifier that annotates requests with a deterministic region hint, an RBAC adapter that enforces policy based on the classifier output and operator scope, and an Audit Entropy Reducer that sanitizes high-entropy KMS metadata before logs are committed.

What this changes: 1) New service: authz/location_classifier - small, dependency-free classifier using request claims and IP-region mappings to produce a stable 'location_hint' label. 2) RBAC adapter: authz/rbac_adapter_location that extends RBAC v2 decision flow with a location check and operator-scoped deny rules. 3) Audit pipeline stage: audit/entropy_reducer - configurable rules to redact or hash select KMS headers and remove per-request non-deterministic tokens while preserving provenance tags required for compliance. 4) Config: new feature flag and policy options under config/security.location_classification and config/audit.entropy_reduction.

Backwards compatibility: The classifier is opt-in via feature flag; if disabled the adapter falls back to existing tenant-claim checks. Audit reducer is enabled for customers who opt into 'reduced_entropy' audit mode. No existing RBAC policies are removed; new condition keys are additive.

Testing done: Unit tests for classifier heuristics and policy evaluation (location priority), integration test that runs a mocked KMS header through the audit pipeline and asserts redaction/hash behavior, and e2e in local dedicated environment validating rejection of cross-region operator actions. CI: full unit and integration suites run in GH actions; low-risk canary on internal staging for 48h before full rollout.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flags. 2) Canary enabled for internal tenants and a small external pilot. 3) Collect logs and metrics for 72h: authz.location_mismatches, audit.redactions_count, classifier.confidence_p50. 4) If stable, flip default audit mode for new tenants and document upgrade path for existing tenants.

Related work: ENG-9234 (policy UX), SEC-214 (audit privacy requirements). Docs change tracked in a follow-up PR to redwood-docs.

review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Overall this looks good. Two asks: make classifier deterministic across restarts (suggest persisting seed) and add a performance budget for the reducer. Can you add benchmarks?

Priya Menon: Thanks Ethan — added a deterministic hashing seed persisted to local disk with a rotation window and added microbenchmarks for reducer (see audit/entropy_reducer/bench_test.go). Updated description with performance metrics: ~0.25ms per request overhead on p3.2xlarge equivalent in our harness.
Sofia Martinez: Policy evaluator looks solid but can we expose a debug flag to log location hints only for admin tenants? Helps debugging without leaking audit-sensitive fields.
Priya Menon: Added admin-only debug flag under config/security.log_location_hints. It is disabled by default and gated to internal tenants via allowlist.
Liam O'Connor: Integration tests flaked earlier on CI due to test ordering; approved after fix and re-run. Verified canary metrics in staging for 48hrs.

Security review (automated comment): Threat modeling checklist OK. No high severity findings. Minor note: ensure audit hashing uses HKDF with tenant-specific salt — implementation uses tenant_id prefix as salt.
CI bot: Integration suite passed (rerun after fix).
Merge queue: squash and merge allowed.
release_notes: Added optional location-based RBAC adapter and an audit entropy reducer to sanitize KMS metadata. Feature flagged and opt-in; improves compliance posture for region-sensitive tenants. See docs/notes/2026-03-location-classifier.md for rollout steps.
